name: @lawmind/api
//exports: Briefing assembly is domain logic the nightly sweep needs too. Exported rather than duplicated, and rather than moved to packages/ for one consumer — the ponytail ladder says the cheapest correct change wins. recheck joined it 8 Aug 2026 for the same reason and one more: the API needs it for POST /admin/overruled-rechecks/run, and cron already depends on api rather than the reverse, so moving it HERE removed a cross-package import instead of adding a package.
//llm-exports: Added by NEW1, 14 Aug 2026, additively. The harness makes DeepSeek calls for GENERATED (never gold) query-expansion material, and CLAUDE.md §5 says every model call rows into llm_calls with no exceptions. Exporting callModel keeps the harness ON that ledgered path; the alternative was a second HTTP client in the harness, which is exactly how a call escapes the ledger. NOTE FOR ANYONE ADDING MORE: a comment key must live HERE, at the top level, never inside `exports` — every key inside `exports` is parsed as a subpath, and a key not starting with './' invalidates the whole map. Putting this note inside it broke `@lawmind/api/search/*` resolution for the entire harness until typecheck caught it.
//app-export: Added by NEW1, 22 Aug 2026, additively, for the same reason as //llm-exports above. LAUNCH_BENCHMARK_V1 must measure the REAL production path, and the real path is the Hono app: the 500-char validator, answerStructured's exact-identity gate, embedQuery's 2s budget, THEN hybridSearch. A harness that imports only ./search/retrieve skips the first three and reports a number about a function rather than about the product -- production-route-benchmark.ts did exactly that and its dense arm never ran. Exporting the app is strictly additive; nothing in services/api changes behaviour, and createApp already takes its deps by injection so the harness supplies its own sql and embedQuery.
